info.title: Roles, grants, and permissions HTTP Endpoints
info.description:
API endpoints for managing roles, grants, and permissions in Sanity projects and organizations.

Learn more about [roles, grants, and permissions](https://www.sanity.io/docs/content-lake/roles-concepts).

### Errors
Errors return a JSON body with `statusCode`, `error`, and `message`. A request that fails validation returns `400` with a `validation` object that names the invalid fields. Request bodies reject unknown fields.

A missing permission returns `401`, not `403`, with `code` set to `missing_grant`. Bad grant or resource parameters return `422`.

apiVersion.description: API version. These endpoints require v2021-06-07 or later.

get.description:
List the users and robots in a project and their roles. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.members`.

Without the `roles` parameter, the list includes members who have no roles. With it, the list only includes members who have at least one of the given roles.

parameters.name: roles[]
parameters.description:
Only return users who have at least one of these roles. Use the `roles[]` form, for example `?roles[]=editor` or `?roles[]=editor&roles[]=viewer`.

A single plain `?roles=editor` returns `400` with the message `roles must be an array`. Duplicate role names also return `400`.

200.description: List of users and their roles

get.description: Get the roles of a specific user in a project. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.members`.

parameters.name: projectUserId
parameters.description: The project user ID, which starts with `p`. A Sanity user ID, which starts with `g`, returns `400`.

200.description: User role information

404.description: The user isn't in the project, or has no roles in it

put.summary: Add a role to a user
put.description:
Add one or more roles to a user in a project. Send `roleName` for one role, or `roleNames` for several. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.members`.

Set `deleteExistingRoles` to `true` to also remove the user's other roles in the project. When you do, the request fails if it would leave the project without an administrator.

A role can only be given to robots if its `appliesToRobots` is `true`, and to users if its `appliesToUsers` is `true`. Only a project administrator can add or remove the `administrator` role.

parameters.name: projectUserId
parameters.description: The project user ID, which starts with `p`

201.description: Roles updated. The response has no body. It also returns `201` when the user already had the roles.

400.description: The request is invalid, the role can't be given to this kind of user, the request would leave the project without an administrator, or a non-administrator tried to change the `administrator` role.

404.description: The user or the role wasn't found in the project

delete.summary: Delete a role from a user
delete.description:
Remove a role from a user in a project. Send `roleName` to remove one role. Omit `roleName` to remove all of the user's roles, which removes the user from the project and ends their project sessions. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.members`.

A project must keep at least one administrator. Only a project administrator can remove the `administrator` role.

parameters.name: projectUserId
parameters.description: The project user ID, which starts with `p`

200.description: Role removed successfully

400.description: The request is invalid, would leave the project without an administrator, or a non-administrator tried to remove the `administrator` role

404.description: The user or the role wasn't found, or the user doesn't have the role

get.description:
Get a list of all members and their roles in an organization. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.organization.members`.

The list only includes roles given directly to members. Roles a member gets through project membership aren't listed.

parameters.name: roles[]
parameters.description:
Only return members who have at least one of these roles. Use the `roles[]` form, for example `?roles[]=administrator`.

A single plain `?roles=administrator` returns `400` with the message `roles must be an array`.

200.description: List of organization members and their roles

get.summary: Get the roles of a single organization member
get.description: Get the roles of a specific member in an organization. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.organization.members`.

parameters.name: sanityUserId
parameters.description: The Sanity user ID, which starts with `g`

200.description: Member roles information

404.description: The user has no roles in the organization

put.summary: Give an organization member a role
put.description:
Add a role to an existing member of an organization. You can't use this endpoint to add new members. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.organization.members`.

Set `deleteExistingRoles` to `true` to also remove the member's other roles in the organization. When you do, the request fails if it would leave the organization without an administrator.

parameters.name: sanityUserId
parameters.description: The Sanity user ID, which starts with `g`

200.description: The member already had this role. If `deleteExistingRoles` is `true`, the member's other roles are still removed. The response has no body.

201.description: Role added successfully. The response has no body.

400.description: The request is invalid, the role can't be given to users, or the request would leave the organization without an administrator

404.description: The user isn't a member of the organization, or the role wasn't found

delete.summary: Remove a role from an organization member
delete.description:
Remove a role from a member in an organization. Send `roleName` to remove one role. Omit `roleName` to remove all of the member's roles, which removes the member from the organization. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.organization.members`.

An organization must keep at least one administrator.

parameters.name: sanityUserId
parameters.description: The Sanity user ID, which starts with `g`

200.description: Role removed successfully

400.description: The request is invalid, or would leave the organization without an administrator

404.description: The member or the role wasn't found, or the member doesn't have the role

get.summary: Get all grants for current user
get.description: Get all grants for the current user in an organization, including grants from roles the user gets through project membership. The user must be a member of the organization.

200.description: Grants for the current user, grouped by permission resource type

401.description: The current user isn't a member of the organization

post.description:
Add a grant to a custom role in an organization. A grant gives the role a permission on a permission resource. Identify the resource with `permissionResourceId` or `permissionResourceName`.

You can only add grants to custom roles. Requests for a built-in role return `400` with the message `Can not modify grants on a non-custom role`. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.organization.roles`.

200.description: The grant already existed, or its parameters were updated. Returns the grant configuration.

201.description: Grant created. Returns the grant configuration.

404.description: The organization, role, permission resource, or permission wasn't found

delete.description:
Remove a grant from a custom role in an organization. The request body has the same shape as when you create an organization grant. You can only remove grants from custom roles. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.organization.roles`.

A grant only matches if `params` is exactly the same as when the grant was created. If nothing matches, the request still returns `200` with `deletedGrants` set to `0`.

200.description: Returns the number of grants removed

404.description: The organization, role, permission resource, or permission wasn't found

get.description:
Get the access control list for a dataset, as it applies to the caller. Each entry pairs a GROQ filter with the permissions granted on documents that match it. Filters that use `user::attributes()` are resolved for the current user.

This endpoint doesn't require a token. Without one, it returns only the entries that apply to everyone.

200.description: Dataset ACL information

get.description: Get the current user's document grants for a dataset. The user must be a member of the project.

200.description: The current user's document grants, grouped by permission resource type. Returns an empty object if the user has no roles.

401.description: The current user isn't a member of the project

404.description: The project or dataset wasn't found

get.summary: List grants for the current user
get.description: List the project-level grants for the current user in a project. The user must be a member of the project.

200.description: The current user's project-level grants, grouped by permission resource type

401.description: The current user isn't a member of the project

post.description:
Add one or more grants to a custom role in a project. A grant gives the role a permission on a permission resource. Identify the resource with `permissionResourceId` or `permissionResourceName`. Users get the grant when they're assigned the role. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.roles`.

You can only add grants to custom roles. Requests for a built-in role return `400` with the message `Can not modify grants on a non-custom role`.

To add several grants to the same role, send `roleName` and a `grants` array instead. The grants are added together: if one fails, none are added.

200.description: No grants were created, or at least one grant's parameters were updated. Returns the grant configuration, or an array of configurations when you send `grants`.

201.description: At least one grant was created and none were updated. Returns the grant configuration, or an array of configurations when you send `grants`.

404.description: The role, permission resource, permission, tag, or dataset wasn't found

delete.description:
Remove one or more grants from a custom role in a project. The request body has the same shape as when you create a grant. You can only remove grants from custom roles. Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.roles`.

A grant only matches if `params` is exactly the same as when the grant was created. If nothing matches, the request still returns `200`.

200.description: Request processed. Returns the grant configuration, or an array of configurations when you send `grants`, whether or not a matching grant existed.

404.description: The role, permission resource, permission, tag, or dataset wasn't found

get.summary: List grants for a project member
get.description: List the project-level grants for a specific member of a project. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.members`.

parameters.name: projectUserId
parameters.description: The project user ID of the member, which starts with `p`

200.description: The member's grants, grouped by permission resource type

404.description: The user isn't in the project

get.description:
List all roles in a project, including built-in roles, ordered by name. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.roles`.

A built-in role can appear twice with the same name: once for users and once for robots. Check `appliesToUsers` and `appliesToRobots` to tell them apart.

200.description: List of roles

post.description: Create a custom role in a project. Requires the `create` permission on `sanity.project.roles`, and the project must have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature.

400.description: The request is invalid, the role name is reserved, or the project doesn't have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature

409.description: A role with this name already exists. Names are compared case-insensitively.

get.description:
List the permission resource schemas available to projects, such as `sanity.project.members`, `sanity.document.filter`, and `sanity.document.filter.mode`. Each schema defines a type of permission resource and the permissions you can grant on it. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.roles`.

To list the permission resources in a project, use `GET /projects/{projectId}/permissionResources`.

200.description: List of permission resource schemas. The example shows one entry; the response contains every project schema.

get.description: List the permission resources in a project, both built-in and custom, ordered by ID. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.roles` or `sanity.organization.projects`.

200.description: List of permission resources

post.description:
Create a custom permission resource in a project. Set `permissionResourceType` to the name of a permission resource schema, and set `config` to match that schema's configuration. For `sanity.document.filter`, `config.filter` is a GROQ filter. The filter can't be empty, and can't contain a full query (`*`) or a dereference (`->`).

If you omit `name`, you can only refer to the resource by its ID.

Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.roles`, and the project must have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature.

permissionResourceType.description: The name of the permission resource schema to base the resource on

name.description: A unique name for the resource. Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. Can't start with `res-` or `sanity`.

config.description: Configuration that matches the permission resource schema's `config`. Unknown keys return `422`.

400.description: The request is invalid, or the project doesn't have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature

404.description: The permission resource schema in `permissionResourceType` wasn't found

409.description: A permission resource with this name already exists

422.description: `config` is missing, doesn't match the schema, or has an invalid filter

get.description: Get a permission resource in a project. Requires the `read` permission on `sanity.project.roles` or `sanity.organization.projects`.

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: The ID or name of the permission resource. Values that start with `res-` are treated as IDs.

200.description: Permission resource

put.description:
Update the title, description, or configuration of a permission resource. Sending `config` replaces the whole configuration. You can't change `name` or `permissionResourceType`.

This endpoint also updates built-in resources.

Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.roles`, and the project must have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature.

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: The ID or name of the permission resource

config.description: Configuration that matches the permission resource schema's `config`. Replaces the existing configuration.

200.description: Permission resource updated

400.description: The request is invalid, or the project doesn't have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature

422.description: `config` doesn't match the schema, or has an invalid filter

delete.description:
Delete a permission resource, and remove every grant that uses it. This endpoint also deletes built-in resources, which removes the matching grants from built-in roles.

Requires the `update` permission on `sanity.project.roles`, and the project must have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature.

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: The ID or name of the permission resource

200.description: Permission resource deleted. The response has no body.

400.description: The request is invalid, or the project doesn't have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature

apiVersion.description: API version. Role mappings require v2022-12-21 or later.

put.description:
Create, update, or delete project role mappings for SAML SSO. The request changes only the mappings it names; other mappings are left alone.

- An item without `id` creates a new mapping. Sending the same item twice creates two mappings.
- An item with `id`, `roleName`, and `groupRule` updates that mapping.
- An item with `id` and an empty or `null` `roleName` and `groupRule` deletes that mapping.
- `fallbackRoleName` sets the role for users who match no mapping. Set it to `null` to remove the fallback, or omit it to leave the fallback unchanged.

Sending `roleMappings` requires the project to have the `authSAMLRoleMapping` feature. Setting only `fallbackRoleName` doesn't.

### Robot Tokens
This endpoint cannot be accessed using robot tokens.

### Authorization
Requires the `saml` permission for the `sanity.organization.sso` resource. Send the token in the `Authorization` header; session cookies aren't accepted.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSO provider

200.description: Role mappings created or updated. Returns the mappings the request created or updated, including the fallback mapping.

400.description: The request is invalid, `groupRule` uses the reserved fallback value, or the `Authorization` header is missing

403.description: The project doesn't have the `authSAMLRoleMapping` feature

404.description: The project doesn't belong to the organization, or the provider or a mapping `id` wasn't found

delete.description:
Deletes all project role mappings for a specific SSO provider and project within an organization, including the fallback mapping. For use with SAML SSO implementations.

### Authorization
Requires the `saml` permission for the `sanity.organization.sso` resource. Send the token in the `Authorization` header; session cookies aren't accepted.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSO provider

200.description: Role mappings deleted successfully

404.description: The project doesn't belong to the organization, or the provider wasn't found

delete.description: Delete a custom role in a project. You can't delete built-in roles, or roles that are assigned to users or robots. Requires the `delete` permission on `sanity.project.roles`, and the project must have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature.

200.description: Role deleted successfully

400.description: The request is invalid, or the project doesn't have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature

409.description: The role is assigned to users or robots

422.description: The role is a built-in role

put.description:
Update a custom role in a project. Send only the fields you want to change. You can't rename a role, and you can't update built-in roles.

Requires the `create` permission on `sanity.project.roles`, and the project must have the `advancedRolesManagement` feature.

appliesToUsers.description: Whether the role applies to users. You can't set it to `false` while users have the role.

appliesToRobots.description: Whether the role applies to robots. You can't set it to `false` while robots have the role.
